audit.whatIsWrong: Arctic Assault was called 'her E'; the slows were attributed to Permafrost; Winter's Wrath was described as percent-HP damage.
audit.why: Riot text: Arctic Assault is Q (650 range charge, knockup, 18/16.5/15/13.5/12s). Winter's Wrath is W — two mace swings, damage, slow, Frost stacks, no percent-health. Permafrost is E, a 1.5s-cooldown stun usable only at max Frost stacks. Fury of the North also grants immunity to slows while Frost Armor holds, so Radiant Blast's slow does nothing on first contact.
audit.corrected: Slots and effects corrected throughout; Frost Armor slow immunity stated; Arctic Assault's 18s rank-1 cooldown given as the step-up window.

audit.whatIsWrong: Advice said to auto 'when her E is on cooldown' — Permafrost is 1.5s and effectively always up.
audit.why: The punishable cooldown is Arctic Assault at 18s rank 1, not Permafrost.
audit.corrected: Step-up window re-keyed to Arctic Assault.

edits.before: She edges this window: Permafrost slows let her walk you down and stick her dash before your level 6 ranged spike comes online.
edits.after: She edges it: Winter's Wrath slows let her walk you down into Arctic Assault before your level 6 ranged spike arrives.

edits.after: Your evolved E adds missing-health magic on every ranged auto, shredding her stacked tank HP under R invuln — Winter's Wrath is a double mace swing and a slow, and a solo tank cannot out-scale a full-build Kayle.

edits.before: Good news first: Sejuani is a tank with no execute and middling base damage, so unlike a Renekton or Riven she literally cannot kill you in lane levels 1-3. This is the rare early window you don't have to concede — last-hit with your melee autos, top up any chip with W, and poke with Q (Radiant Blast) when she steps up to farm, shredding her armor in the process. The one thing that ends you is her E, Arctic Assault: never stand on a minion wall she can dash through, because that dash into a Permafrost stun plus a jungler is the only way she scores a kill before you reach 6.
edits.after: Good news first: Sejuani is a tank with no execute and middling base damage, so unlike a Renekton or Riven she literally cannot kill you in lane levels 1-3. This is the rare early window you don't have to concede — last-hit with your melee autos, top up any chip with W, and poke with Q (Radiant Blast) when she steps up, shredding her resistances; Frost Armor makes her slow-immune, so first contact your Q only chips. The one thing that ends you is her Q, Arctic Assault: never stand on a minion wall she can charge through, because that knockup into a Permafrost stun plus a jungler is her only kill before 6.

edits.before: Level 6 is your breath of air: Divine Ascent turns your autos ranged with bonus-magic AoE waves and R hands you a few seconds of invulnerability, so you finally out-range a melee tank and can farm without eating an Arctic Assault for free. She'll still try to walk you down with Permafrost slows into her dash, so kite back with W move speed and only step up to auto when her E is on cooldown. Don't greed for a solo kill — she's too tanky to burst here — just win the CS race and save R for the dash-stun so her gank attempts come up empty.
edits.after: Level 6 is your breath of air: Divine Ascent turns your autos ranged with bonus-magic AoE waves and R hands you a few seconds of invulnerability, so you finally out-range a melee tank and can farm without eating an Arctic Assault for free. She'll still walk you down with Winter's Wrath slows stacking Frost into her charge, so kite back with W move speed and step up to auto only once Arctic Assault is down — 18 seconds at rank 1. Don't greed for a solo kill — she's too tanky to burst here — win the CS race and save R for the knockup so her ganks come up empty.

edits.before: This is where you pull ahead in the pure 1v1: a solo tank does not out-scale a full-build Kayle. Once you have 2+ items, your evolved E (Starfire Spellblade) adds missing-health magic damage to every ranged auto, shredding her stacked HP faster than her Winter's Wrath percent-HP chunks you, and R invuln blanks her all-in. The real threat is never her dueling you — it's her Permafrost slows, Arctic Assault dash-stun, and Glacial Prison AoE stun setting up your death for the rest of her team in fights. Position at max range, hold R for yourself against her engage, and let her be a CC bot while you melt her whole side of the map.
edits.after: This is where you pull ahead in the pure 1v1: a solo tank does not out-scale a full-build Kayle. Once you have 2+ items, your evolved E (Starfire Spellblade) adds missing-health magic damage to every ranged auto, shredding her stacked HP faster than Winter's Wrath's double swing chips you, and R invuln blanks her all-in. The real threat is never her dueling you — it's Winter's Wrath stacking Frost into a Permafrost stun, Arctic Assault's knockup, and Glacial Prison's AoE stun setting up your death for her team in fights. Position at max range, hold R for yourself against her engage, and let her be a CC bot while you melt her whole side of the map.
